steps.name: count
steps.cmd: docker compose exec -T db psql -U learner -d workshop -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM notes"

steps.name: dump
steps.cmd: docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U learner -d workshop -Fc -f /tmp/notes.dump

steps.name: disaster
steps.cmd: docker compose exec -T db psql -U learner -d workshop -c "DELETE FROM notes"

steps.name: restore
steps.cmd: docker compose exec -T db pg_restore -U learner -d workshop --clean --if-exists --single-transaction /tmp/notes.dump

steps.name: count again
steps.cmd: docker compose exec -T db psql -U learner -d workshop -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM notes"

steps.name: major version 16
steps.cmd: docker compose exec -T db psql -U learner -d workshop -tAc "SELECT current_setting('server_version_num')::int / 10000"

steps.name: copy to 17
steps.cmd: docker compose -f compose.pg17.yaml cp backups/notes.dump db:/tmp/notes.dump

steps.name: restore into 17
steps.cmd: docker compose -f compose.pg17.yaml exec -T db pg_restore -U learner -d workshop --no-owner /tmp/notes.dump

steps.name: count in 17
steps.cmd: docker compose -f compose.pg17.yaml exec -T db psql -U learner -d workshop -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM notes"

steps.name: major version 17
steps.cmd: docker compose -f compose.pg17.yaml exec -T db psql -U learner -d workshop -tAc "SELECT current_setting('server_version_num')::int / 10000"
